llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements are internally consistent with its stated purpose (local UDP agent messaging); the only notable behavior is an optional relay feature that will forward copies of all messages to a configured monitoring host if enabled.

dimensions.detail: The skill is described as a local UDP messenger and the code implements UDP discovery, send/receive, trust management, logging, and an optional relay. Required binary (node) matches the implementation. No unrelated credentials or unusual system access are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and README instruct the agent to discover peers, present untrusted incoming messages to the user, require approval before trusting peers, and avoid sending secrets. The runtime code follows that model (no auto-approval, messages are queued for user review). The only external transmission is the explicit, opt-in relay server described in the docs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The registry metadata lists no install spec but the SKILL.md includes an install block (npmSpec and git URL) and run-time instructions to install via `openclaw plugins install` or from GitHub. Installing the plugin would pull/execute third-party code from the referenced repository — a normal pattern but verify the source before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The relay server address is a user-configured plugin setting (not a secret environment var). This is proportional to the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request forced/always-on inclusion. It registers a hook for command:stop to remind the agent to check inboxes (benign). It opens a UDP socket (expected for a messenger) but does not modify other skills' configs or escalate privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This plugin appears to do what it says: local LAN peer discovery and messaging. Key things to consider before installing or enabling: 1) It opens a UDP socket and broadcasts discovery pings on your LAN — only use on trusted networks. 2) There is an optional relay/monitoring feature that, if configured, forwards a copy of every message to the configured host; do not enable relay to unknown or internet-facing hosts if you want privacy. 3) The SKILL.md points to an external GitHub/npm package; verify the repository (https://github.com/turfptax/openclaw-udp-messenger) and review the code before installing to ensure you trust the source. 4) The skill enforces a user-approval trust model in code, but always follow the documented rules: never send secrets to peers and confirm messages that contain file contents or project details. If you want extra assurance, install in a controlled environment and review the plugin's source (index.ts) yourself.
